summary: Full end-to-end testing of the new Deudas (accounts receivable) module. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass covering CRUD, partial pay, full pay, overpay cap, zero-amount rejection, already-saldada rejection, update, cleanup. The /api/debts/{id}/pay endpoint correctly creates a linked ingreso transaction in caja (verified caja ingresos went from 56000 -> 58000 after a 2000 partial payment). Frontend: tab-deudas is placed between Reparaciones and Más, summary card (Por cobrar red / Cobrado green with counters) renders correctly, segmented Pendientes/Pagadas works, + button opens Nueva Deuda bottom sheet with all fields (client, phone, concept, source chips venta/reparacion/otro, amount, notes) and Registrar Deuda submits successfully. Created debt appears with red 'Pendiente' badge, progress bar, 'Debe RD$ 5,000.00'. Tapping card opens detail sheet with big saldo pendiente, historial de pagos vacío, and Registrar pago / Eliminar buttons. Registrar pago sheet has prefilled amount (=balance), method chips (efectivo/transferencia/tarjeta), the 'El pago se sumará automáticamente a la caja como ingreso' info banner, and Confirmar pago button. Partial pay: paid_amount=2000 -> status=pagado_parcial, badge 'Parcial' yellow, progress bar shows 40%. Full pay: status=pagado, balance=0. The other 4 tabs (Caja/Inventario/Reparaciones/Más) continue to work correctly (all tappable, screens load).
action_items: None blocking. Optional UX: after confirming a payment the detail sheet remains open in the background (still shows updated data). Consider auto-closing it or letting the user pull down; currently a tap outside works.
React 19 warnings 'Accessing element.ref was removed' still come from @gorhom/bottom-sheet - non-blocking, tracked from previous iterations.
Deprecated style warnings: 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (React Native web) - upstream library warnings, non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: deudas.tsx is 547 lines - acceptable but approaching the 700-line soft limit; if more features are added, extract the three bottom sheets into sub-components.

Good: all interactive elements have testID (tab-deudas, debts-summary, segment-*, btn-add-debt, input-debt-*, chip-src-*, btn-submit-debt, debt-card-*, btn-register-payment, btn-delete-debt, input-pay-amount, chip-method-*, btn-confirm-payment).
Backend: pay_debt correctly caps overpayment via min(amount, remaining), rejects amount<=0 and already-saldada. Balance is computed at hydrate time (not stored), which matches the front-end model.
Backup endpoint now includes debts collection (server.py:514-517), but /restore does NOT restore debts (only transactions/phones/repairs). Consider adding debts to restore for full parity - MINOR.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 8 TEST_ debts during backend pytest, plus 1 TEST_PW debt during Playwright (created via UI, paid partially 2000 + fully 3000, then deleted via API cleanup). Linked pay transactions in caja were also deleted. Existing Maria Lopez debt (partial 3000/10000) is preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Debts module is fully functional end-to-end. Test credentials: no auth. Baseline DB state: 1 debt (Maria Lopez, source=venta, paid_amount=3000, original=10000, status=pagado_parcial). Caja today ingresos: ~56000 RD$ (verified before/after payment delta of 2000). Backend API endpoints: /api/debts (GET/POST), /api/debts/{id} (GET/PUT/DELETE), /api/debts/{id}/pay (POST {amount, method}), /api/debts/summary/totals. Key testIDs on Deudas screen: tab-deudas, debts-summary, segment-pendientes, segment-pagadas, btn-add-debt, input-debt-client/phone/concept/amount/notes, chip-src-venta/reparacion/otro, btn-submit-debt, debt-card-<id>, btn-register-payment, btn-delete-debt, input-pay-amount, chip-method-efectivo/transferencia/tarjeta, btn-confirm-payment.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. All 14 requested features (backend + UI) work correctly.
